name: Doubleview Gold Corp.
summary: Doubleview Gold Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral resource properties in Canada. The company explores for cobalt, scandium, copper, gold, silver, and zinc deposits. Its flagship project is the 100% owned Hat Project which consists of nineteen mineral claims covering approximately an area of 18,000 hectares located in northwestern British Columbia. The company was formerly known as Doubleview Capital Corp. and changed its name to Doubleview Gold Corp. in May 2020. Doubleview Gold Corp. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
